integrity: The continuum statement is reduced analytically to signed-facet faces of a compact polytope. The bundled exact-arithmetic checker exhausts all 1728 facet triples over Q(sqrt(3)), verifies all face endpoints, and certifies the common supporting facets used on each nondegenerate segment. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns one canonical two-dimensional polyhedral norm. It does not classify all regular polygonal norms with G_L=6 or all non-Hilbert spaces having Euclidean derived equilateral lengths. Bibliographic searches cannot establish absolute novelty.
title: Euclidean equilateral derived lengths in the regular dodecagonal plane
